info.name: Worldline Card Issuing Account - AccountState Merchant API

params.name: acquirerId
params.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

params.name: iban
params.description: International Bank Account Number for merchant payments

params.name: holdingId
params.description: Unique identification of the holding, determined by equensWorldline

params.name: merchantId
params.description: Unique identification of the merchant, determined by the acquirer

params.name: merchantName
params.description: Name of the merchant

params.name: postalCode
params.description: Postal code of business address.

params.name: houseNumber
params.description: Housenumber of business address. Note, Postalcode must be given too

params.name: terminalId
params.description: Identification of the terminal. Within the Dutch model a terminal ID uniquely identifies one specific physical device. Within other terminal models the terminal ID is only considered unique within the context of its own site (card acceptor ID)

params.name: cardAcceptorId
params.description: Unique identification of the site in accordance with payment scheme rules. Some Dutch acquirers have a waiver not to fill this field. In that case it contains the merchant ID

params.name: sortField
params.description: Sort field

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Page size (Max page size is 300)

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number

items.docs:
This operation retrieves a list of merchants. Terminated merchants are excluded.

If there is a previous and/or next page the http response header will have a link (url) to this data
